entities.summary: Luo Xiaojuan is a Chinese freestyle wrestler. She won one of the bronze medals in the 62 kg event at the 2022 World Wrestling Championships held in Belgrade, Serbia. She is a two-time gold medalist at the Asian Wrestling Championships.
